Sound familiar?

You care deeply. Your energy hasn’t kept up.

  • You say yes to every cause, call and meeting, and rest feels like letting people down.
  • The news follows you to bed and you wake up already tired.
  • You give to your community all day and have little left for the people closest to you.
  • You know looking after yourself matters, but the usual self-care advice doesn’t fit your life.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why caring so much can leave you drained

A simple, trauma-informed way to understand stress, so you notice it earlier and respond with kindness.

The 3-minute daily check-in

Pause, notice, name it, ask what you need. A practice you can use anywhere, even on the busiest day.

Boundaries for change-makers

How to say no kindly, so you protect your energy for the work that matters most to you.

An introduction to tapping (EFT)

A short, guided tapping practice you can use to settle yourself before a hard conversation or a long day.

From self-care to community care

How to build rest and support into the groups you’re part of, so no one has to carry it alone.

Script 1 · “Rest is part of the work”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you give a lot of yourself to the causes you care about, this one’s for you.”

Body

“So many change-makers I talk to give everything to their work and their community, and leave very little for themselves. Rest isn’t quitting. It’s how you keep going for the long haul.”

CTA

“I’m sharing the tools I use in a live 60-minute masterclass. It’s £17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera against your orange backdrop. On-screen line: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “The 3-minute check-in”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s a three-minute practice I come back to every day.”

Body

“Pause. Notice where you’re holding tension. Name what you’re feeling, without judging it. Then ask: what do I need right now? It sounds small. Done daily, it changes how you show up.”

CTA

“We’ll practise it together in the Sustainable Change-Maker Masterclass. 60 minutes, £17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, the four steps appear as on-screen text in burnt orange.

Script 3 · “A kind no”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Saying no to one more thing can be how you say yes to the cause.”

Body

“Boundaries aren’t selfish. They protect the energy you need for the work that matters most. Try this: ‘I care about this, and I can’t take it on right now.’ Kind, clear, and you don’t owe a long explanation.”

CTA

“I’ll share more scripts like this in my live masterclass. Seats are £17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a card with the script written out.
